Maria (partnerships): Quick sync — OrchX (ISV) requested a joint-launch plan for their orchestration + LangChain adapter. They want marketplace listing and a co-blog. Can we confirm timeline and owners? :wave:

Alex H.: I can own engineering onboarding + test harness. Need to know adapter API surface. Do they publish a LangChain/LLM wrapper or a gateway plugin?

Jamie L.: They're shipping both: a LangChain connector and a lightweight gateway plugin. They sent a draft adapter (link shared). Need marketing assets and logo files.

Sasha K.: Questions for runtime team — which model variants should we recommend for their demos? Also need a compatibility matrix: LangChain >=0.0.40 and LlamaIndex >=0.6. We'll verify on our side.

Kevin P.: For the demo we should pin to rwd/small-8k-quant on Dedicated to keep latency sub-200ms. I'll produce benchmark numbers (p95) and an autoscale config snippet:
```
service: orchx-demo
model: rwd/small-8k-quant
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 8
  cpu_threshold: 65
```

Alex H.: Also need a quickstart code block for customers. Draft:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=\"${REDACTED}\")
resp = c.chat(model=\"rwd/small-8k-quant\", messages=[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"summarize\"}])
print(resp.text)
```

Jamie L.: Marketing: share hero screenshot + 1-pager by next Wed. We plan co-blog on Thu the 22nd. Is that still ok from infra side?

Sasha K.: Infra ok if we lock model and quota. Need OrchX to opt into our gateway routing policy (policy: prefer-dedicated, fallback-hosted). I'll add an env var requirement in the compatibility doc.

Maria (partnerships): Action items — Alex (eng onboarding + quickstart) / Kevin (benchmarks + autoscale) / Sasha (compat doc + gating policy) / Jamie (marketing assets + blog). I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri 10am PT. Everyone ok? :calendar:
